page.layout: Running head at top centre; heading line below it; a woodcut emblem picture in a frame across the middle; a verse stanza with a large initial below the picture; catchword at lower right. One printed page.

p.i: Incauto quicunque rosas collegerit ungue, Vix unquam illaeso legerit ungue rosas: Hoc sapite exemplo locupletes, plurima namque Hisce latent vestris spicula mixta rosis.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a man in a plumed hat and doublet, reaching with one hand into a rose bush while a thorn-covered stem catches his sleeve; a dog or boar-like animal and a hillside with a town appear at the left. No marginal notes. The large initial I of the verse is a decorative letter. Long s printed as s is given as s. The woodcut is not transcribed as text.
